sources.query: SELECT count(*)::float8 AS landed, COALESCE(sum((properties->>'amount')::numeric),0)::float8 AS volume, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (properties->>'isfraud')::boolean)::float8 AS flagged FROM paysim_demo.graphnode WHERE label='transaction'
SELECT count(*)::float8 AS actors FROM paysim_demo.graphnode WHERE label <> 'transaction'
SELECT action, count(*)::float8 AS transactions, round(sum(amount),2)::float8 AS amount FROM paysim_demo.payments GROUP BY action ORDER BY transactions DESC
SELECT transaction_id, sender_name, receiver_name, action, amount::float8 AS amount FROM paysim_demo.payments ORDER BY timestamp DESC, transaction_id DESC LIMIT 10
